desc: Ideate the core algorithm (MST + Greedy Matching with DSU).

Implement the solution in Python using Kruskal's algorithm to build the MST, then use a DSU-based greedy approach to calculate the minimum sum of bottleneck distances by processing edges in ascending order of weight.
Check edge cases (e.g., $K=1$, linear graph, star graph).
Ensure input reading handles large inputs efficiently (using `sys.stdin.read`).
